claims: Second-seeded UConn defeated third-seeded Michigan State 67-63
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16
UConn advanced to the Elite Eight
Tarris Reed Jr. and Alex Karaban hit key free throws in the final minute
The venue was Capital One Arena in Washington D.C.
UConn jumped to an early lead of 25-6
Michigan State took a 45-44 lead in the second half
Tarris Reed Jr. had 5 rebounds for UConn
Alex Karaban had 7 rebounds for UConn
UConn advances to play No. 1 Duke in the Elite Eight
Michigan State finished their season in the Sweet 16
Michigan State was led by Tom Izzo
Michigan State came back from a 19-point deficit
